theme.archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Tactical HUD & Gamified)
theme.description: A high-visibility, command-center aesthetic inspired by modern gaming HUDs and tactical vehicle navigation. Uses deep obsidian backgrounds with high-contrast neon accents for route clarity, avoiding cliché purples and teals.

body.styling: increased tracking for legibility at small sizes

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Tactical Minimalism. Every element is deliberate, optimizing for one-handed thumb use and rapid glanceability.

borders.radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons/avatars, rounded-3xl for bottom sheets
borders.style: 1px solid strokes preferred over soft shadows to define edges in low light

hud_elements.description: Floating panels over the map (ETA, speed, next turn)
hud_elements.classes: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-2xl

bottom_navigation.classes: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-zinc-950 border-t border-zinc-800 pb-safe pt-2 px-4 flex justify-between items-center z-50

buttons.primary: bg-yellow-500 text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-yellow-400 active:scale-95 transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white font-medium hover:bg-zinc-700 active:scale-95 transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-3 border border-zinc-700
buttons.fab_report: bg-red-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-red-500/30 rounded-full w-14 h-14 flex items-center justify-center hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-transform

cards.vehicle_profile: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-3 hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer
cards.report_item: bg-zinc-900/80 rounded-xl p-4 border border-zinc-800 flex gap-4 items-start

gamification.xp_bar: h-2 w-full bg-zinc-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden relative
gamification.xp_fill: absolute left-0 top-0 h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-lime-500
gamification.badge: w-16 h-16 rounded-xl border-2 border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 flex items-center justify-center shadow-[inset_0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)] text-2xl

map_dark.description: Dark abstract map representation, use as background behind routing UI when actual map component is mocked.

driving_ambience.description: Neon-lit night driving scene, useful for onboarding screens or premium upsell background.

sports_car.description: Sports car driving through neon tunnel, use for Garage/Vehicle selector.

avatars.description: Gamer profile avatar for user settings and leaderboard.

badges.description: Diamond shapes on black background, use for XP/Level badges.

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples below:

motion_and_interactions.routing: Use stroke-dashoffset animation for drawing the route line on the map.
motion_and_interactions.sheets: Framer motion spring physics for bottom sheets (stiffness: 300, damping: 30).
motion_and_interactions.gamification: Number counter animation for XP gains, slight pop/scale effect when badges are earned.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a web-based replica of a React Native mobile app. Use a mobile-first constrained layout (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto h-screen relative overflow-hidden bg-black) to simulate the phone screen.
Implement a fixed Bottom Navigation bar for tab switching (Map, Community, Garage, Profile).
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for tactical UI iconography (crosshairs, map pins, alerts).
For the Map screen, mock the actual map with the provided dark map background image, and overlay UI components (HUD) using absolute positioning with glassmorphism classes.
Avoid standard Vercel/Shadcn aesthetics. Use the provided 1px borders, dark zinc backgrounds, and neon yellow/green accents.
Ensure headings use uppercase tracking-tight utilities to match the 'Barlow Condensed' tactical feel, even if using fallback sans-serif fonts.
